subject: Operational roadmap: Mutual delivery schedule for Solaris Systems onboarding
messages:
From: Ellen Ng <ellen.ng@solaris.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@solaris.com, rajesh.kumar@solaris.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: delivery schedule & milestone owners for onboarding

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team and I are ready to move forward but need a compact milestone plan so our internal stakeholders can sign off (procurement, security, and engineering). Can you share a Mutual Delivery Schedule that lists:
- Major milestones (integration, data validation, pilot, go-live)
- Suggested owners (both Redwood and Solaris)
- Target dates and any hard constraints (audit windows, blackout dates)

If possible, please include a single-sheet attachment we can circulate internally. We aim to have an internal readout on Oct 28th, so a first-pass doc this week would be ideal.

Thanks,
Ellen Ng
CTO, Solaris Systems

Attachments: none
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Ellen Ng <ellen.ng@solaris.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: delivery schedule & milestone owners for onboarding

Ellen — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a compact Mutual Delivery Schedule (MDS) draft: Solaris_Mutual_Delivery_Schedule_v1.xlsx. High-level items below, with dates we think are realistic given scope discussed. Please review and flag anything that needs tightening for your Oct 28 readout.

Proposed milestones (owners / target):
- Kickoff & environment provisioning: Redwood (Karthik) / Solaris (Infra lead) — target: Nov 3
- Integration sprint (API + auth): Redwood (Ben) / Solaris (Eng lead) — Nov 6–Nov 17
- Data validation pass (sample data): Redwood (Monica) / Solaris (Data) — Nov 20
- Pilot (internal users): Redwood CS (Marissa) / Solaris Product — Dec 1–Dec 8
- Go-live readiness & compliance review: Redwood (Karthik) / Solaris Security (Rajesh) — target: Dec 15

Open items for your team to confirm: any blackout dates in Nov/Dec, required SLAs for pilot, and whether procurement needs a separate acceptance checklist.

I attached the MDS file and kept it intentionally compact — one sheet with owner, deliverable, date, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.

Next steps:
1) Quick review from your side by Friday Oct 23 so we can iterate for your Oct 28 readout.
2) If accepted, schedule a 60-minute kickoff the week of Nov 1 (calendar link in follow-up).

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: Solaris_Mutual_Delivery_Schedule_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Ellen Ng <ellen.ng@solaris.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: delivery schedule & milestone owners for onboarding

Ellen — added a couple of CS-facing acceptance criteria and a short integration checklist (attached) that procurement usually requests. Ben and Monica, please confirm dev/integration estimates inline below.

Minor edits to Karthik's dates:
- Recommend starting integration sprint Nov 8 to accommodate Solaris' Thanksgiving-week blackout if present — Ben, can you confirm 2-week window is sufficient?
- Pilot scope: recommend 100–200 users for a representative traffic profile; Marissa to run success metrics (latency, error rate, annotation accuracy).

Procurement note: include an 8-week lead for contract signature if Solaris requires a SOC2 indemnity addendum. I attached integration-checklist.md for your procurement and security review.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: integration-checklist.md (text)
From: Ellen Ng <ellen.ng@solaris.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Rajesh Kumar (Security) <rajesh.kumar@solaris.com>, procurement@solaris.com
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: delivery schedule & milestone owners for onboarding

Thanks, Marissa/Karthik — this is helpful. Two quick asks from security and procurement:
1) Security needs to schedule a short evidence review window around Nov 22–24; Rajesh, can you confirm acceptable times? If that conflicts with Thanksgiving or other blackout windows, we may need to shift the pilot.
2) Procurement wants the acceptance criteria added to our SOW appendix; procurement@solaris.com, please advise on timelines — we typically need 6 weeks to process contract addenda.

I've attached a short request with SOC-coverage items we commonly ask for. If Redwood can confirm delivery of the SOC checklist items by Nov 10, procurement will prioritize our request.

Ellen Ng
CTO, Solaris Systems

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (pdf)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Ellen Ng <ellen.ng@solaris.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, procurement@solaris.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: delivery schedule & milestone owners for onboarding

Ellen — appreciate the quick turn. Quick updates:
- Rajesh: we can reserve Nov 23 for the evidence review (30–60 minutes), and Karthik/Monica will lead the session. If that date is blocked on your side, propose Nov 24.
- Ben confirms the integration sprint can run Nov 8–Nov 19 (two full weeks) if we freeze the API contract by Oct 30.
- Procurement: we'll add the acceptance criteria to the SOW appendix and share an updated SOW by Nov 3 to keep a 6-week review buffer.

I'll post the kickoff calendar invite for Nov 2 at 10am PT and include the MDS and checklist links. If anyone needs a different cadence, reply-all and we'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=solariskickoff

Attachments: none
